name: Secret Royals
overview: An international high-budget docu-dating reality series documenting modern romance within European high society and aristocratic networks. The format tracks prominent eligible bachelors and bachelorettes, including Prince Wenzeslaus of Liechtenstein, Count Henri de Polignac, and Baron Christian von Pfetten, alongside selected high-profile international cultural figures such as Joanna Modes under her heritage billing "Princess of Svaneti". Filmed across Monaco, Paris, and London, the series explores social etiquette, diplomacy, and elite courtship, concluding its original run following the expiration of its broadcast licensing agreements in Q2 2007.
